description: Visualize activity patterns as a heatmap — see which hours of the day and days of the week have the heaviest usage. Shows both cost and token intensity. Use this to understand work patterns and peak usage times. Built from individual records, so the default (all) scope covers the last 14 days.

metric.description: Heatmap metric: cost, tokens, or records (default: cost)

scope.description: Time scope: today, week (last 7d), month (calendar month), or all (default)

name: tokmeter_heatmap
